purpose: Workflow guide for writing requirements documents by reverse-engineering an existing application's source code, extracting features while keeping function and renewing design.
summary: Required reading list of requirement principles, format, boundary, priorities, and style guide documents
Purpose: extract requirements from existing source code, preserving features while renewing design
Phase 1: user confirmation, rules and specs retrieval, parallel rules/code context-collection agents
Phase 2: source code analysis of project structure, screens, navigation, and design element handling
Phase 3: requirement extraction priority order and practical steps for actions, branches, persistence, errors
Feature extraction checklist per screen or function
Phase 4: placement decision, ID numbering via next-spec-id, creation order, What-only principle, glossary
Phase 5: quality checks, AI review, specs ToC update, commit confirmation, completion guidance
tasks: Creating requirements documents from an existing application source code
Rebuilding a legacy app on a new architecture
Extracting screen, function, business logic, and data requirements
title: 要件定義書作成ワークフロー（既存アプリ解析版）
